ModMetaData.name: RimAgent
ModMetaData.author: mushroomTW
ModMetaData.description:
RimAgent — an LLM agent for RimWorld colony management.
Open the Agent tab and give a natural-language instruction. RimAgent reads the colony through explicit tools, performs only requested game actions, and records every call in the action log.
Requires RimLLM Framework 2026.10.18.3 or later. Configure providers, API keys, models and fallback chains in RimLLM Framework; RimAgent supplies colony tools and per-category permissions.
All tool categories are enabled by default and configurable in mod settings: observation, work, build, combat, trade, medical, prisoners, animals, zones, production, time, MCP, web search and memory. Web search uses Parallel Search MCP anonymously by default, with optional local SearXNG; neither needs an API key. Web search follows the current mode's command policy. Memories are short files in two scopes: names starting with `global_` are shared by every save (kept in the RimAgent data folder), the rest are saved with one game; each instruction receives their index and the agent reads files when relevant. Observation includes colonist wellbeing (needs, thoughts and equipment); work supports batch priorities; build includes hunting designations.
Modes are selected in the Agent window. Ask is read-only. Confirm requires confirmation for every command. YOLO (between Confirm and Auto) excludes blacklisted high-risk tools and runs everything else directly without confirmation. Auto uses an LLM safety review for every command: only low-risk, requested actions run; rejected actions report a reason without asking the player to confirm. Autonomous operates via background scheduler without blacklist or budget restrictions, with configurable cooldown (default disabled). It reacts to emergencies and to base upkeep problems such as dangerous temperatures, missing beds, beds outdoors, no power in use, no research project and low moods; a condition that persists is retried with backoff, and the conversation reports when the agent gives up. When nothing is wrong it pushes one improvement forward on a fixed cadence. Player instructions have no configured per-instruction tool-call limit.
Older tool results are compacted automatically. The resizable conversation distinguishes player messages, agent replies and tool results, shows inline screenshot previews, and reports provider-supplied input tokens for the latest main-model request when available. Goals run independently of Autonomous mode, continue until verified complete or paused, and obey the current command mode. Optional run-history logging is off by default and stores up to 500 JSONL records or 16 MiB in a separate file. The visible transcript, compacted model session, goal state, autonomous scheduler state, this save's memories and work undo history are saved with the game; global memory is kept outside the save in the RimAgent data folder. Autonomous mode aggregates every map and reacts to raids starting or ending, mental-break risk, food shortages, downed or bleeding colonists and fire.
MCP tools run as local processes with your user privileges; MCP execution requires confirmation in Confirm mode, passes safety review in Auto mode, and executes directly in YOLO and Autonomous modes.
